<style class="gs-config">
/* LK round — the funnel restyled into a Level Kitchen «program-configurator»
   (levelkitchen.com/spb, inspected 2026-08-16: .program-selection / .program-calories /
   .program-day chip lists + a right-hand live menu column + a floating summary bar).

   CSS ONLY, and every selector is #orderFunnel-scoped. Hard limit 3 stands: no node is
   added, removed, renamed or reparented, no id/name/data-* is touched, and no click
   handler is intercepted — order-funnel.js keeps driving exactly the same DOM it shipped.
   Specificity: funnel internals are single-class (0,1,0) and the funnel injects its CSS
   in-body, so ID-scoping (1,x,0) wins independent of source order. This band sorts last
   among ours, so it also settles ties with 05/06/07/08.

   The one behavioural-looking rule is the duration dropdown: [data-pdd] .of-dd__menu is
   promoted from an absolutely-positioned popover to a static chip grid, which is what
   makes the screen read as a configurator instead of a form. It is display/position only.
   The .d-none toggle order-funnel.js:603/617 still runs; it simply no longer decides
   visibility, and clicks on [data-duration] are bound to the options themselves
   (order-funnel.js:608-619), not to the open state — so selection is unaffected.
   Scoped to [data-pdd] on purpose: the checkout dropdown ([data-cdays]) keeps its
   popover behaviour. */

/* ── screen 1 · «Выбор программы» / «Объём» ─────────────────────────────── */
#orderFunnel .of-hero__title{letter-spacing:-.03em}
#orderFunnel .of-offer{border-radius:20px}
/* LK section headings: the funnel ships .of-label as a 13px uppercase caption */
#orderFunnel .of-label{font-size:22px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.03em;
  text-transform:none;color:#20271A;padding:10px 2px 6px}
/* LK «Объём» grid — two columns of calorie cards instead of one tall column */
#orderFunnel .of-plans{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px}
#orderFunnel .of-plan{border-radius:18px;border-width:2px;border-color:#E3E8DE;
  padding:16px 14px;gap:10px;background:#fff}
#orderFunnel .of-plan.is-selected{border-color:#3F6B39;background:#DCEBC4}
#orderFunnel .of-plan--popular{border-color:#3F6B39}
#orderFunnel .of-plan__main{flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:4px}
#orderFunnel .of-plan__title{font-size:26px;line-height:1}
#orderFunnel .of-plan__num{font-size:26px}
#orderFunnel .of-plan__unit{font-size:15px;color:#4E5748}
#orderFunnel .of-plan__price{font-size:16px;font-weight:800;color:#3F6B39;white-space:normal}
#orderFunnel .of-plan__hr{margin:2px 0}
#orderFunnel .of-plan__foot{flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:6px}
#orderFunnel .of-plan__meta{font-size:12px;line-height:1.4;color:#4E5748}
#orderFunnel .of-plan__cta{font-size:13px;white-space:normal}
#orderFunnel .of-plan__badge{top:-10px;right:auto;left:12px;font-size:11px;padding:5px 11px}
@media (min-width:900px){#orderFunnel .of-plans{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)}}
/* order-funnel.css:28 reserves min-height:70vh on .of as a mobile screen-fill. The 4-column
   grid above makes screen 1 far shorter than that on desktop, and browser zoom-out grows the
   CSS viewport, so the unused reserve paints as a blank band before the next section that
   widens with every zoom step. Desktop-only on purpose: below 900px the content exceeds 70vh
   anyway, and mobile keeps the platform's screen-switch reserve. ID out-specifies .of. */
@media (min-width:900px){#orderFunnel{min-height:0}}
/* User round: the funnel header («4 шага до здорового рациона» + the offer card) restated
   tariff info that gsPlans «Ваш тариф» now owns at the page end, so screen 1 opens straight
   with «Выберите меню». Hidden, not removed: hero_title stays in 10-funnel.json because its
   <h1> is the page's only one (qa.py enforces exactly one) and .of-hero/.of-offer carry no
   controls or data-* logic (static markup, verified in preview-v1444). */
#orderFunnel .of-screen[data-screen="menu"] .of-hero,
#orderFunnel .of-screen[data-screen="menu"] .of-offer{display:none}

/* ── screen 2 · the configurator itself ─────────────────────────────────── */
/* «Продолжительность»: popover -> static chip list. display/position only. */
#orderFunnel [data-pdd].of-dd.of-fcard{display:flex;flex-direction:column;
  background:transparent;border:none;padding:0;gap:10px}
/* With the menu permanently open the trigger no longer opens anything: its click handler
   (order-funnel.js:601-605) still toggles .d-none, which no longer decides visibility. A
   chevron that does nothing is worse than no chevron, and the chip grid below already
   shows the selection, so the dead control is hidden. Its [data-pdd-label] node still
   exists and still receives applyPeriod()'s text — the summary bar in 80-orderbar reads
   it, and nothing in the funnel depends on it being painted. */
#orderFunnel [data-pdd] .of-dd__trigger{display:none}
#orderFunnel [data-pdd] > .of-dd__menu{order:2;display:grid!important;
  grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px;position:static;background:transparent;
  box-shadow:none;border-radius:0;overflow:visible}
#orderFunnel [data-pdd] .of-dd__opt{flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:4px;
  background:#fff;border:2px solid #E3E8DE;border-left-width:2px;border-radius:16px;
  padding:14px;font-size:17px;font-weight:800;color:#20271A;min-height:86px;
  justify-content:center;transition:border-color .15s,background .15s}
#orderFunnel [data-pdd] .of-dd__opt:hover{background:#F4F8EE}
#orderFunnel [data-pdd] .of-dd__opt.is-selected{border-color:#3F6B39;background:#DCEBC4}
#orderFunnel [data-pdd] .of-dd__price{font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:#3F6B39}
#orderFunnel [data-pdd] .of-dd__opt.of-pair-off{opacity:.45}
#orderFunnel [data-pdd] .of-fcard__total{order:3;background:#fff;border:1px solid #E3E8DE;
  border-radius:16px;padding:14px 16px;font-size:15px;color:#4E5748}
#orderFunnel [data-pdd] .of-fcard__total-val{font-size:20px;color:#3F6B39}
/* Chips live in the 360px sticky side column on >=900px (of-cols--2 grid), so 4 columns
   yield 78px chips: labels wrap, prices wrap, the -50% badge folds into an ellipse
   (user screenshot). 2 columns stay correct at every width the column can have. */

/* «Заменить» in the meal cards: order-funnel.css sets size and weight but no font-family,
   and buttons do not inherit it, so the label rendered in the UA font and read as foreign
   (user screenshot). Geometry matched to the chip radius so cards and chips agree. */
#orderFunnel .of-meal__replace{font-family:inherit;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;
  padding:9px 10px;border-radius:999px;border:1.5px solid #CFE3C7;background:#F4F8EE;color:#2C4E28}
#orderFunnel .of-meal__replace:hover{background:#DCEBC4}
/* The menu placeholders («Загружаем меню…» / «Загружаем ещё…») paint as bare text on the
   band background; on a slow connection that is a near-blank screen. A card face plus a
   height reserve keeps the list area readable while batches arrive. */
#orderFunnel [data-meals] .of-hint{background:#fff;border:1px solid #E3E8DE;border-radius:16px;
  padding:18px;text-align:center}
#orderFunnel .of-screen[data-screen="preview"] [data-meals]{min-height:180px}
/* Mobile: order-funnel.css:661-678 pins the whole side column sticky at top:0 and
   order-funnel.js:25-46 slides it away (translateY(-110%)) on downward scroll. That design
   assumed the compact dropdown form; the LK chip grid made the column viewport-tall, so on
   a phone it "flies up" and leaves its full-height sticky slot as bare background before
   the day list starts (user report). Static flow removes both the flight and the void; the
   floating .of-mbar already keeps price and «Далее» reachable on mobile. transform:none
   neutralises the .is-hidden class the JS keeps toggling. */
@media (max-width:899px){
  #orderFunnel .of-screen[data-screen="preview"] .of-col--side{position:static;transition:none;will-change:auto}
  #orderFunnel .of-screen[data-screen="preview"] .of-col--side.is-hidden{transform:none}
}

/* «Дата первой доставки» + предпочтения — LK card row */
#orderFunnel .of-frow{margin-top:10px;gap:10px}
#orderFunnel .of-fcard{border-radius:16px;border-color:#E3E8DE}
#orderFunnel .of-datecard__date{font-size:15px}
#orderFunnel .of-datecard__time{font-size:13px;color:#4E5748}
#orderFunnel .of-btn--pref{border-radius:16px}
/* the day/time popover and the preview calendar inherit the same rounding */
#orderFunnel .of-menucal,#orderFunnel .of-cal{border-radius:16px}

/* the live menu column — LK «actual-menu-list» */
#orderFunnel .of-day__title{font-size:19px;letter-spacing:-.02em}
#orderFunnel .of-day__sum{font-size:13px;color:#4E5748}
/* User round: each day is a horizontal snap row instead of a vertical grid. The old
   2-col (3-col desktop) grid stacked every dish of every day into one long wall;
   a per-day row shows the day at a glance and cuts the vertical scroll to one card
   height per day. (1,1,0) beats both the base grid and its desktop twin (media
   queries add no specificity). Cards keep min-width:0 from the platform so the
   in-card Swiper cannot inflate the row. */
#orderFunnel .of-day__grid{display:flex;gap:10px;overflow-x:auto;overscroll-behavior-x:contain;
  -webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;scroll-snap-type:x proximity;padding-bottom:6px}
#orderFunnel .of-day__grid > .of-meal{flex:0 0 156px;scroll-snap-align:start}
@media (min-width:900px){#orderFunnel .of-day__grid > .of-meal{flex-basis:190px}}
#orderFunnel .of-meal{border-radius:16px;border:1px solid #E3E8DE;box-shadow:none}
#orderFunnel .of-meal__name{font-size:14px;line-height:1.3;color:#20271A}
#orderFunnel .of-meal__type{color:#4E5748}

/* ── the floating summary bar (LK .summary-container) ───────────────────
   The funnel's own mobile bar is the summary on screen 2; the page-level twin lives in
   80-orderbar (.gs-summary) and hides itself while the funnel is on screen, so exactly
   one bar is ever visible and both wear this geometry: detached, rounded, floating. */
#orderFunnel .of-mbar{left:12px;right:12px;bottom:12px;bottom:calc(12px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
  flex-direction:row;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:12px 14px;border-radius:22px;
  border-top:none;background:#20271A;
  box-shadow:0 18px 40px -16px rgba(32,39,26,.55)}
#orderFunnel .of-mbar__price{flex:1;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:0;
  justify-content:center;color:#fff;text-align:left}
#orderFunnel .of-mbar__val{font-size:20px;color:#fff}
#orderFunnel .of-mbar__lbl{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:#C3DF9C}
#orderFunnel .of-mbar__btn{width:auto;flex:0 0 auto;padding:14px 22px;border-radius:999px}
/* the funnel reserves 116px of bottom padding for the old flush bar (order-funnel.css:657);
   the detached bar sits 12px higher, so the reserve grows to match */
#orderFunnel .of-screen[data-screen="preview"] .of-body{padding-bottom:132px}
/* Animation off (user request). order-funnel.css:118-133 fades and slides every child of
   the menu screen in on staggered delays; the cards start at opacity 0, so the rule must
   restore opacity as well as cancel the animation, or a cancelled animation would leave
   them invisible. transform:none clears the paired slide. */
#orderFunnel .of-screen[data-screen="menu"] .of-body > *,
#orderFunnel .of-screen[data-screen="menu"] .of-plan{
  animation:none;opacity:1;transform:none}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  #orderFunnel .of-plan,#orderFunnel [data-pdd] .of-dd__opt{transition:none}}
</style>
